versions.changelog:
- Added an explicit, detailed safety & compliance warning, clarifying that this skill provides only product management workflow templates and does not include executable code for scraping or auto-publishing.
- Generalized and refactored workflow and terminology to support any multi-platform video automation SaaS product (not just YouTube/X→B站)，with strictly enforced compliance and copyright sections throughout.
- Updated and clarified all workflow stages, checklists, and EARS templates to use more neutral wording (e.g., “内容采集/分发” instead of“搬运”), emphasizing API/ToS compliance and legal considerations.
- Removed the sample card documentation file (skill-card.md).
- Streamlined and improved the structure, making the workflow universally adaptable for various video translation, subtitle, and distribution platforms, with a stronger focus on requirement traceability and team responsibility.
- Added troubleshooting and tips with a greater emphasis on compliance, legal risk, and best practices for product requirement management.

Initial release of bili-tech-video-automation: a complete workflow for automating overseas tech video migration, AI Chinese translation, and automatic Bilibili publishing.

- Provides an end-to-end workflow covering requirements planning, PRD (EARS-based), design review, task tracking, testing, and launch retrospective.
- Focuses on automated video fetching, speech recognition, translation, subtitle merging, formatting for Bilibili, compliance checks, and auto-publishing.
- Includes prioritized requirements pool (P0–P3), PRD templates, evaluation criteria, test case coverage, bug management, and retrospective guidelines.
- Emphasizes compliance, risk control, detailed handoff documents, and full-lifecycle project management best practices.
- Suitable for SaaS/tool product planning, requirement writing, project review, development tracking, and operational iteration for video automation needs.
